title: Private Christmas Walking Tour in Quebec Old Town Heritage
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This private walking tour immerses you in Quebec’s historic winter charm. You wander ancient streets dusted with snow and pass St. John Gate, echoing centuries of heritage. At City Hall, festive lights accentuate classical architecture. Place Royale glows with colonial elegance. Stroll along Petit-Champlain and inhale the aromas of traditional winter treats. Visit the German Christmas Market, with music and seasonal traditions enriching the experience. Watch syrup bubble at La Petite Cabane à Sucre while savoring a maple delicacy. Conclude at Dufferin Terrace with panoramic views of Château Frontenac over the St. Lawrence.

Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
